title: Detect schema drift before publication
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. The reported provider schema is evidence, separate from the local typed snapshot. cloud_expected_schema is the independently defined contract. FULL JOIN on dataset and column_name catches missing and unexpected fields; compare data_type exactly. Add the number of duplicate dataset/column groups. A float declaration for exact money violates the contract even if the current local NUMERIC rows look correct. Reported types are data; the importer never executes DDL from them.
learning_objectives: Separate execution, quality and incomplete evidence.
